entry.title: Updated: dsh-pets
entry.summary: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet. Exact install spec: @hellosz/dsh-pets. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
